base_domain.description: Default domain used for internal reference when no specific domain context is available.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging; recommended values: debug, info, warning, error.

log_file.description: Path to a log file. Leave empty to log to stderr instead.

server_host.description: Default WHOIS server hostname used for queries without domain-specific overrides.

server_port.description: Port number on which the WHOIS server listens (standard is 43).

connect_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for connection before timing out.

ipv6_enabled.description: Whether to attempt IPv6 connections to WHOIS servers when available.

cache_enabled.description: Enable caching of repeated queries for improved performance and reduced server load.

cache_dir.description: Directory path where cached WHOIS responses will be stored.

cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live for cached entries, in seconds. Entries older than this will be refreshed.

cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries allowed in the cache.

response_rules.description: List of domain-specific override rules that match incoming queries to custom WHOIS servers.

name.description: A descriptive name for this rule (e.g., 'example-org').

pattern.description: Regex or simple wildcard pattern to match domain names against (e.g., '*.example.com' or '^test-.*\.').

server_host.description: WHOIS server to use for matching domains.

server_port.description: Port for the custom server (optional; defaults to 43 if omitted).

timeout.description: Per-query timeout (in seconds) for this rule (optional; defaults to global connect_timeout if omitted).
